name: svg-mask-effect
title: SVG Mask Reveal
blurb: SVG mask spotlight that expands on hover to reveal content.
description: A two-layer reveal component using SVG masking with smooth motion animations. Spotlight mask follows cursor and expands on hover with background color transition.
use_when: An interactive hero section or content reveal with animated spotlight effect.
avoid_when: On mobile or touch devices — no cursor to track. Requires /mask.svg asset in public folder.
a11y: Both layers are in DOM but mask obscures one. No keyboard control; animation is decorative.
